mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.created_at AS createdAt, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expenseCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND e.is_settlement = false THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpenseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.transaction_type = 'INCOME' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncomeAmount, p.age_household_type AS ageHouseholdType, p.spending_habit_type AS spendingHabitType, p.investment_propensity_type AS investmentPropensityType, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS savingsTier, MAX(e.created_at) AS lastExpenseAt, s.lastLoginAt FROM users u LEFT JOIN expenses e ON e.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(created_at) AS lastLoginAt FROM sessions GROUP BY user_id ) s ON s.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.created_at, p.age_household_type, p.spending_habit_type, p.investment_propensity_type, s.lastLoginAt ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
